SURFACE STRUCTURE, in order: compact 64px horizontal top brand/navigation; 100px heading area; one horizontal benchmark tab row; a modest horizontal vendor-filter and model-selection toolbar; a dominant wide bordered white chart card with approximately 420px plotting height; compact reported-results table below; low-key footer. No left sidebar or right rail. Maximum content width1320px and 70px side margins. The visitor selects benchmark/model filters, compares score against measured task cost and follows evidence links. This is professional familiar category-standard analytics dashboard design, premium through precise typography, spacing and alignment.

Visual world: white/off-white cool light ground, palette #ffffff white, #142235 dark navy text, #3f6fdb blue selected controls. Neat8px radius panels, subtle pale gray1px borders, plain modern Geist/system-like sans, crisp small solid icons. Chart occupies largest region. No decorative imagery, blueprint, material metaphor, marketing hero, KPI/statistic cards, invented statistics, pricing or claims.

Top: compact small blue chart icon and exact product name "AI Benchmarks" at left; navigation "Benchmarks" selected, "Models", "Methodology"; small "GitHub ↗" at right. Main exact heading "Compare the frontier." 34px navy; subtitle "Compare capability. Understand the cost." at16px gray.

Right end dropdown "More models" indicating unchecked model choices without expanding over the chart. No fictional reported results for unreported models. Small "Design preview" note.

Three rows: "Opus 5.5" / "Main set" / "Anthropic ↗"; "Sonnet 5.5" / "Main set" / "Anthropic ↗"; "GPT-6 Sol" / "Main set" / "Anthropic ↗". Do not fabricate numerical score or cost cells.
